about: Player-facing changes, newest first, for comparing play counts before and after each one. Published with the public web build as changes.json. at: when it went live (the merge to main, UTC). builds: which builds it reached (demo, playtest). kind: gameplay, balance, onboarding, ui, content, fix, tracking, page. watch: the play-count paths (without the itch-demo/ prefix) expected to move, and which way.

changes.title: Hangar opens in the first minute, and the walk-through points at the right buttons
changes.notes: The Hangar tab used to appear only after a machined part (three disciplines in), and 36% of new players never saw it. It now opens at Salvage level 2 or the first steel plate, about a minute in, and pulses until visited. The fitting step names the frame as the Hangar shows it (e.g. 'Fit Gantry', not 'Fit the Stevedore'), Show me picks the sealant bay, and the next button to press scrolls into view.

changes.title: Warning when the browser won't keep the save
changes.notes: About 5% of opens couldn't save (save/blocked). The game now checks storage on load and, if it's blocked, says so at the top of the page with a Save code button, before the player puts time in.
watch: fewer of those players lost: watch returning opens

changes.title: Dropdowns stay open long enough to pick from
changes.notes: Reported in the itch comments: dropdowns closed before anything could be picked. The screen redraws several times a second and replaced the open dropdown whenever what that screen showed changed (Stores while work runs, the Hangar during sorties and production). Redraws now wait while a dropdown is open. Affects the standing-orders editor in the walk-through, the pilot and saved-fit pickers, the surplus line and the sortie companion.

changes.title: Feedback link to the itch comments
changes.notes: A Feedback button in the top bar (and in Settings, the Help start page and the end-of-demo card) opens the itch page's comments in a new tab. Counted as feedback/open.

changes.title: Counts for onboarding steps, errors and lost saves
changes.notes: New paths: start/work, start/foundry, start/hangar, start/hangar-visit, start/fit, start/skill, start/orders, start/sorties (each step before the first sortie, with a save-time bucket; only bases that haven't sent a sortie yet count them); error/<code> with the message as its title; save/blocked (the browser refused to store the save); save/unreadable (a stored save failed to load). Nothing changed for players.

changes.title: Playtest tools: game speed and checkpoint bases
changes.notes: Settings gets game speed and seven checkpoint bases in the playtest build only. A base that uses either is a test base and sends no play counts, so the playtest page's numbers may drop slightly from here.

changes.title: Warnings for standing orders the fit can't fire
changes.notes: The orders editor, the fitting screen and the sortie launch panel warn when a pilot's standing orders can never fire with the fit (no weapon for the action, or no sonar for wind-up orders). Mostly matters from the shelf and canyon onward.

changes.title: Screen size and device on play counts
changes.notes: Every count carries the screen size (GoatCounter's Sizes panel), and each open counts device/phone, device/tablet or device/desktop. Device counts start here; nothing changed for players.

changes.title: Demo goes public on itch
changes.notes: slowlichen.itch.io/breakwater switched to the demo build (through the Warden, level 45) and made public. The baseline: the Melvor-style layout, fitting stats, fight backdrops and damage numbers were all already in.
